hero.title: Gautama Buddha: Life and Enlightenment
hero.description: A comprehensive analysis of the life of Siddhartha Gautama, the founder of Buddhism, within the historical context of the 6th-century BCE Shramana movement.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Lumbini (Birth)
  • Bodh Gaya (Enlightenment)
  • Sarnath (First Sermon)
  • Kushinagar (Mahaparinirvana)

Personalities

  • Suddhodana (Father)
  • Mahaprajapati (Aunt/Step-mother)
  • Yashodhara (Wife)
  • Rahula (Son)
  • Channa (Charioteer)
  • Early Life: Born as Siddhartha in the Shakya clan; prophecy of becoming a Chakravartin or a Buddha.
  • Four Sights: Old man, Diseased man, Corpse, Ascetic.
  • Key Doctrines: Four Noble Truths and Eightfold Path (Ashtangika Marga).

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: Critical life milestones of the Buddha (Traditional Dates: 563-483 BCE).

cards.details: Birth at Lumbini (Kapilavastu) to King Suddhodana (Shakya clan) and Queen Mahamaya.
Mahabhinishkramana (Great Renunciation) at age 29 to seek an end to human suffering.
Enlightenment (Nirvana) at Bodh Gaya under a Pipal tree at age 35.

items.title: H.L.D.P.K
items.decryption: Symbols of Buddha's life: Horse (Departure), Lotus/Bull (Birth), Dharma Chakra (First Sermon), Pipal/Bodhi Tree (Enlightenment), Lion/Stupa (Death/Nirvana).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing Buddha's birth place (Lumbini) with his first sermon place (Sarnath).
Assuming Buddha was born in a kingdom, not a republic/oligarchy (Shakyas were a Gana-Sangha).
Attributing the concept of 'Anatta' (No-self) to Jainism; it is unique to Buddhism.
